jobs.tierReason: review of lesson sanitizing (secrets and private data), eval check execution and prompt notes
jobs.prompt: Review Phase 15 part 1 (the lessons loop). Design: docs/plans/phase15-lessons-design.md. New command glue: tools/lessons-commands.mjs; wiring diff: coordination/review/phase15.diff. Rules that must hold: (1) a lesson file can never contain a secret, email, home path, run id, public IP, or long token, and the checks cannot be bypassed by unicode tricks, case, split tokens, or fields the validator forgets (also the redaction function must not leave the sensitive text behind, and error messages and command output must never print the matched text); (2) the store never reads or writes outside the lessons folder or through a symlink (project and id values, temp file handling, overwrite behavior, file size); (3) running an eval check cannot leak the caller's environment or secrets to the checked code, cannot escape its temp folder (outputs and hidden files with .. or absolute paths or symlinks in a fixture or in a worker workspace), always kills the process group on timeout, and always cleans up; the eval spec cannot smuggle other commands through argv; (4) scoreRun and eval score read job workspaces named in a run state file: path traversal and symlink escapes must be refused, and a failed or missing job must score as a failure, never as a pass; (5) notes added to worker prompts cannot carry instructions that change the job (a lesson is data, notes are capped and flat text) and never include private data; (6) eval manifest jobs are sensitive and cannot be routed to rented or third party lanes; (7) the baseline gate cannot be bypassed by a different model key, an empty total, or a malformed baseline file, and a lower score on the same total always fails; (8) backfill is idempotent and cannot overwrite a hand-edited lesson. Find real bugs with file and line evidence, rank high, medium, low, and say how to fix each. Do not edit files.
